title: Middle East live:  Kuwait says it destroyed hostile Iranian drones targeting vital facilities
summary: Kuwait's army on Saturday said it had destroyed hostile Iranian drones ‌in the country's airspace, in what it described as an attack targeting ‌several vital facilities in the country. A government facility ‌in northern Kuwait and a civilian property were hit, the army said, but no casualties were reported. Follow our liveblog for the latest updates.
